name: BodyTalk_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its hands to chest height with open palms in a welcoming, explanatory gesture before returning to a neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises both arms symmetrically, bending its elbows to bring its closed fists up near chest height. It then rotates its forearms outward and opens its hands wide, palms facing up and slightly forward in a gesture of presenting or explaining. After holding this open posture briefly, it smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral starting position.
